title: Statecraft AI-generated visual prototypes
description: These 34 assets are AI-generated visual prototypes for the game. They are not historical evidence, verified depictions, or source material about real people, buildings or vehicles. Names and placements are symbolic game art.
license_summary: Download and use are allowed under the accompanying model license. Selling these models as standalone assets requires permission from their creator.

generation.plan_evidence: Local generation records identify paid-plan output; Max is recorded for the first two batches.
generation.source_images: Original AI-generated concepts, according to the local generation records; concepts and private session records are not included.
generation.export: FBX with base-color textures. Unity materials, prefabs and applicable animation controllers are included.
generation.provenance_note: Hashes describe the current imported bytes, including the farmer eight-animation re-export, rather than superseded local export records.
